doc_friction.issue: Step 0 queue lists 1,186 alerts from an old analysis; the top ones read (#95, #107, #115-117, #102-103) were already fixed by PR #18676. The CodeQL run on main was in progress (run 45537911516, JS job ~30+ min); later pushes cancel each other's pending runs, so the queue refreshes only when one run finishes. Cost ~10 min re-checking work earlier runs had already triaged.

First idea (NIST 800-171 SSP template for machine-shop-guides) was already open as PR #18831; a quick open-PR search found it before building. Free front-door pages for bets #1 and #4 are crowded with open PRs (6 pay-app-guides PRs open).

notes: Idea: payapps (bet #1) launch blocker 'rate limiting on auth routes beyond Better Auth's in-memory limiter'. private-monorepo PR #49: middleware/auth-rate-limit.ts counts in D1 (verification table, conditional-UPDATE fixed window) per IP on every auth POST and per account (SHA-256 of address) on failed password sign-ins only; 429 + Retry-After; fails open on D1 errors; on when hardened, test opt-in header. Verified: typecheck clean, biome clean, unit 68/68, worker 81/81; 4 of 6 new tests fail with the middleware unmounted (the 2 negatives pass both ways). private-monorepo CI has no runners (as documented), so I ran its steps locally. Security queue: no actionable alert; the alerts checked were already fixed on main.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: D1-backed limiter, 6 integration tests and docs for a senior engineer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
